description: Read-only AWS cost-drain scanner across regions with estimated monthly savings
notes: Requires Python 3 on PATH (python.org installer with .py file association, or `scoop install python`). Needs boto3: `python -m pip install --user boto3`. Run: aws-waste-finder --help. Changelog: https://git.canutethegreat.com/CanuteTheGreat/aws-waste-finder/releases
